market.question: Will the highest temperature in San Francisco be between 64-65°F on April 29?

assessment.reasoning: AccuWeather forecast for SFO April 29: high 67°F. The 64-65°F bucket is 2-3°F below forecast. Possible if forecast is slightly off (microclimate variability). Estimate ~15-20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Marine layer fluctuation could pull SFO high lower than central forecast.
